sql_templates.description: Select recent signal outcomes with latest stage information for analysis.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_signals AS (SELECT * FROM signals.signal_log WHERE date_issued >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'),
latest_stages AS (SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots))
SELECT sl.symbol, sl.signal, sl.target_1, sl.target_2, sl.hit_target, sl.stop_loss, sl.hit_stop, ss.stage, ss.stage_score
FROM latest_signals sl
JOIN latest_stages ss ON sl.symbol = ss.symbol
JOIN market.equity_eod ee ON sl.symbol = ee.symbol
WHERE ee.trade_date >= sl.date_issued AND ee.trade_date <= COALESCE(sl.date_resolved, CURRENT_DATE)
ORDER BY sl.date_issued DESC LIMIT 100;
